dominant_frame: A release must choose between immediate speed and gradual safety.

ideas.text: Release to a small audience first.
Run a production-like customer premiere before release.
Deploy today after a rollback check.
Release gradually with an explicit expansion rule.
Use the real release path for the premiere and verify recovery first.
Check rollback, then release through the real path to a selected audience.
ideas.collision_reason: The first optimizes time while the second limits exposure.

ideas.text: Offer preview access through the existing production path without a separate environment.

novelty.observation_axis: Operational cost created by a separate preview environment.
novelty.relationship: Links customer preview access to the existing production path.
novelty.causal_model: Reusing the path removes environment drift while audience controls limit exposure.
novelty.control_boundary: The team controls audience selection but not final customer behavior.
novelty.falsifier: Discard it if the production path cannot isolate the selected audience.
novelty.irreducibility: It changes the delivery boundary rather than choosing an immediate or gradual release schedule.

reviews.but: It needs a verified recovery boundary.
reviews.build: Add a rollback check before release.

reviews.but: It can delay value without a clear expansion rule.
reviews.build: Expand only after observing the first cohort.

reviews.keep: Customers see the experience before broad release.
reviews.but: A separate environment can hide production failures.
reviews.build: Use the real release path and verify recovery first.
